title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Linfield rituals linking new-student welcomes, campus arts, Wildcat athletics, alumni gatherings and graduation.

cards.title: Carry an Acorn from Convocation to Commencement
cards.subtitle: First-year acorns return to an Old Oak bowl at graduation
cards.notes: Keep the acorn presented at Opening Convocation, then return it to the Old Oak bowl when your class crosses the Commencement stage.
cards.short_summary: A small acorn accompanies each undergraduate from the opening of college to graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield says first-year undergraduates receive an acorn at Opening Convocation and return it at Commencement to a bowl made from the Old Oak; the acorns are then passed to the next entering class.
cards.source_title: Opening Convocation to welcome new students, families Aug. 25
cards.access_notes: Participation is associated with undergraduate Opening Convocation and Commencement; consult the current university ceremony schedule.

cards.title: Learn Linfield Lore at Cat Camp
cards.subtitle: A new-student pep rally inside Memorial Stadium
cards.notes: Wear the issued Wildcat spirit shirt and join the stadium program where incoming students encounter Linfield history and traditions.
cards.short_summary: Linfield introduces its newest Wildcats to campus customs through a stadium pep rally.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies Cat Camp as an important tradition and a pep-rally-style event where new students learn university history and traditions.
cards.access_notes: Designed for new students during orientation; family participation and the exact program vary by the published welcome-weekend schedule.

cards.title: Open the Year on Streak Street
cards.subtitle: Lever Street celebrates Wildcat football’s winning-season streak
cards.notes: Check the orientation program, then head to Lever Street for the food trucks, games and music built around the football program’s streak.
cards.short_summary: An orientation street gathering turns a football record into a campus-wide welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s fall orientation schedule describes Streak Street as a tradition on Lever Street celebrating the Wildcat football team’s consecutive winning seasons with food trucks, games and music.
cards.access_notes: Documented in the 2023 orientation schedule; verify whether it appears in the current orientation program before attending.

cards.title: Paint the Senior Bench for Your Class
cards.subtitle: Graduating artists leave a class-specific scene beside Pioneer Hall
cards.notes: Submit a concept during the spring selection period; the chosen artist creates a bench design reflecting the graduating class’s experience.
cards.short_summary: Each graduating class can leave a painted, time-specific record beside Pioneer Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield invites graduating students to apply to paint the Senior Bench, with the selected design expected to represent the class’s experiences, achievements, tone or culture.
cards.access_notes: Painting is limited to the artist or team selected through Linfield’s application process; everyone may view the completed bench outdoors.

cards.title: Close the Semester at Wildstock
cards.subtitle: Linfield’s annual end-of-year concert
cards.notes: Watch the Wildcat Events Board announcements for the spring lineup, location and student-entry requirements before planning to attend.
cards.short_summary: A student-programmed concert supplies Linfield’s musical punctuation mark before year-end.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies Wildstock as its annual end-of-the-year concert and says the Wildcat Events Board organizes the event.
cards.access_notes: The cited page establishes the annual student event but not a current date, venue or admission policy; consult current campus announcements.

cards.title: See Students Build the Lūʻau and Hōʻike
cards.subtitle: Hui O Lōkahi’s long-running spring meal, market and performance
cards.notes: Follow Hui O Lōkahi’s event release for the year’s theme and separate ticket details for the meal and staged cultural performances.
cards.short_summary: Months of student rehearsal culminate in a public celebration of Pacific cultures.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield documented its 51st annual Lūʻau and Hōʻike in 2024, coordinated by Hui O Lōkahi and featuring a meal, Hawaiian marketplace and performance.
cards.access_notes: The annual event is public, but components have used separate tickets; verify the current schedule, capacity and admission terms.

cards.title: Graduate Beneath the Oak Grove
cards.subtitle: Linfield turns its central grove into Commencement Green
cards.notes: Arrive using the university’s ceremony guidance and watch the Oak Grove become the formal stage for the graduating class.
cards.short_summary: The McMinnville campus’s oak canopy becomes Linfield’s outdoor graduation hall each spring.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that it holds Commencement each spring on the McMinnville campus and scheduled the 2026 ceremony on Commencement Green in the Oak Grove.
cards.access_notes: The ceremony is outdoors when conditions permit; follow current guest, accessibility and weather instructions from the university.

cards.title: Watch for the Möbius-Strip Mace
cards.subtitle: A bronze-and-oak artwork formally opens university ceremonies
cards.notes: At a formal Linfield ceremony, look to the opening procession for Nils Lou’s cast-bronze hand balancing a Möbius strip.
cards.short_summary: Linfield begins ceremonial occasions with the entrance of a faculty-made bronze-and-oak mace.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield says its ceremonial occasions begin with the entrance of the university mace, created by art professor Nils Lou with a bronze Möbius-strip head and stained-oak staff.
cards.access_notes: The mace appears during ceremonial occasions; viewing depends on admission to the particular university event.

cards.title: Read the Streak on Mack’s Jersey
cards.subtitle: The mascot’s number changes with football’s winning-season run
cards.notes: At a Wildcat appearance after another winning season is secured, check Mack’s jersey number against the newly extended Streak.
cards.short_summary: The mascot carries Linfield football history as a changing number on his uniform.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield Magazine reports that Mack began wearing a football jersey numbered for The Streak in 2017 and that changing the number as the streak extends remains a tradition.
cards.access_notes: Mack’s appearances vary by event; athletic contests may require tickets even though observing the jersey itself has no separate charge.

cards.title: Welcome Alumni Home at Linfield’s Finest
cards.subtitle: Homecoming’s annual presentation of Linfield alumni awards
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming program for the annual gathering where the university introduces and recognizes that year’s alumni award recipients.
cards.short_summary: A named Homecoming ceremony reconnects alumni while honoring service and achievement.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s report on 2025 Homecoming calls Linfield’s Finest an annual celebration and documents the presentation of four university alumni awards.
cards.source_title: Celebrating beginnings, endings and everything in between during Homecoming Weekend
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Homecoming; verify the current venue, registration rules and attendee eligibility before going.
